name: Burgerstation
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Burgerstation in Tirol!**

Indulge in our mouthwatering burgers made with the freshest local ingredients. Whether you're craving a classic **Tiroler** beef burger or a creative twist with regional flavors, we’ve got you covered.

Pair your meal with a crisp **Tiroler** beer or a refreshing **Apfelschorle**—just like a true **Tiroler** feast!

Located in the heart of **Innsbruck**, our Burgerstation is the perfect stop for food lovers exploring the **Zillertal**, **Ötztal**, or the stunning **Alpenlandschaft**.

Come by and taste the best of **Tirol**—one delicious bite at a time! 🍔✨

---
*Besuch uns in der Burgerstation in Tirol!*
